review_evidence: README explicitly separates policy judgment from Lean-verified mechanics and states that the entry/transaction substrate, per-currency balance invariant, asset/claim classification, and accounting equation are implemented in Lean.
The primary modules Aggregation, Classification, Entry, Transaction, and Examples encode the accounting data model and mechanical invariants rather than only documentation or build machinery.
A declaration scan finds seven theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations alongside the type-level invariant definitions, sufficient to establish an independent verified-mechanics source.
summary: Retain Pacioli, whose Lean half formalizes double-entry accounting mechanics and load-bearing balance/classification invariants.
